title: BG recalculation fallback 2.8.2.2 dev 06/08/2021 and old
body:
Salutations. I am testing all the devs and even with the last one it often happens to me that the loop breaks without errors. Case # 435. And I always have to reinstall the old modified version "Increasing the fallback threshold to 200". It is really sad when it stops during the night and wakes up with blood sugar at 300! Would it be possible to have this setting available in the settings? Possibly only in engineering mode? Unfortunately eversense in some smartphones or configurations from these troubles due to esel !!!! 
When this problem occurs, I realize it because: smb no longer delivers anything since in LOOP it indicates no aps selected and in home under sensitivity it shows NeN.
Thank you.
